text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I love racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I love races that get my heart racing
just from the simple act of running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I love races where Umamusume pour all their energy into chasing a single dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Past the finish line, the world changes in an instant.
A drama woven of records and memories—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You want it, don't you?
That pure, dazzling treasure...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She appeared before me
just as I was harboring such burning passion for racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume of the prestigious Mejiro family,
whose name is known by everyone in the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Isn't there at least one person
who could entertain me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beguiling, enigmatic words and deeds...
She is a difficult woman to describe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, that running style
can be described with just a single word.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
――Aah... perfection. Yes, this is it...
Fufu... ahaha...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nothing short of... 'perfection.'
And her reason for running, that is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"A burning, almost maddening... heat.
Pain. Pleasure..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The one and only thing... that drives me.
Racing—is my love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready?
—Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—I decided to take on the Twinkle Series together with her. Aiming for a brilliant glory that would be an 'unprecedented first.'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —The Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
!
Meaning...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, a press conference was held
for Mejiro Ramonu's debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A prestigious lineage that has produced many great Umamusume—
Bearing the name of the Mejiro family, she is about to make her debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Because of that, merely announcing her debut caused an onslaught of interview requests. To meet the journalists' expectations, a joint press conference was arranged.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"What is your goal for the Twinkle Series?"
...That's what she asked you, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, the Triple Tiara...
shall be placed upon my head.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: The Triple Tiara...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara—a crown that, up to this point
in history, has never once been claimed."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is bestowed upon the one who wins all three Classic Year races: the Oka Sho, the Yushun Himba, and the Shuka Sho.
And as of now—not a single soul has claimed that crown.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: —Mejiro Ramonu... Such incredible confidence. I heard she had already shown tremendous ability, but...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's the Mejiro family!
Maybe this is the year they finally produce a Triple Tiara Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"The history of the Tiara route will change *too*!
—Following in the footsteps of the 'Classic Triple Crown Umamusume'!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The mainstream races of the Classic tier are primarily divided into two routes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One is the Tiara Route that Mejiro Ramonu is aiming for. The other is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The Satsuki Sho, Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby), and Kikuka Sho—collectively known as the Classic Triple Crown of the Classic division.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Winning even a single one of these races is arduous, making sweeping all of them exceptionally difficult. Thus, Triple Crown Umamusume rarely appeared. However—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: —In recent years, we've seen Triple Crown Umamusume born one after another, with Mr. C.B. and Symboli Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Now that the Triple Crown momentum is rolling!
A first-in-history Triple Tiara is also...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: Ms. Mejiro Ramonu! If you don't mind, I'd love to ask you a few questions right away—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: As for what comes next...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I've left everything... in the hands
of my Trainer here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, but I have training to attend to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
So that all of your eyes may be delighted...
I shall continue to hone my running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Well then.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—By the time I finished answering all the reporters' passionate questions...
it was already evening.
choice_data_list: (The expectations were immense... but that's only natural.)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Your track record may be a blank slate, Trainer... but I believe Mejiro Ramonu chose you precisely because you possess a brilliance that outweighs all of that.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: A flawless training schedule, a perfect race plan... Was it really something like that which captured Mejiro Ramonu's heart?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once again, I understood what it truly meant
to walk alongside an Umamusume of her caliber. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —*pant*... *pant*...
choice_data_list: (As I thought, this is the place)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Need to push off harder...
—...Right, next is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Time and time again, up until today, I have watched her run with stoic determination.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
And to dedicate a flawless, absolute victory
to the masterpiece of a race born from it...
That is the proof of my love.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, the way for me...
to prove my love for the racing I adore so much is—"
choice_data_list: (Together with her, we will claim the Triple Tiara.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I will achieve a Triple Tiara like no one has ever seen before,
and carve a new chapter into racing history."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu's running will surely pave the way to the future.
That is why...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Shh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I'm focusing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, after waiting for a little while—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: It is already done.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Ah, however... I would be delighted to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: If you are confident that you love racing more deeply than I do, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Well then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To say I love racing more deeply than she does... honestly, I'm not so sure. But my passion isn't shallow enough to back down just from hearing that.
choice_data_list: I'll make a dish that will blow you away...!
I'll create a menu that will make you roar with approval...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Well then, good day to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so...
Our challenge for the Twinkle Series alongside the perfect Umamusume,
Mejiro Ramonu, had begun!
